341256.mechanism: The source checked every response-matrix entry except the interior boundary vertex's diagonal entry. Response matrices of connected resistor networks have zero row sums (constant potentials carry no current), so that entry equals minus the sum of already-checked entries in its row; under the wider whole-row/column reading, the column sums do the same. The conjecture therefore follows from the source's own reported verification plus a classical fact: a zero-credit bridge. Figure geometry is not recoverable from the text layer, and no independent recomputation was made.
